audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere (the packet flagged zero sequencing cues), the cage was never described as destructible, Mourning Mist's armour shred and ghoul-homing mark were missing entirely, and the anti-heal timing was untied to Last Rites.
audit.why: Riot kit: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s and summons a destructible wall — you can break a segment instead of waiting it out. Mourning Mist (12/11/10/9/8s, 700 range) reduces armour, slows and marks, and his summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets, so being marked is what pulls the swarm onto you. Last Rites is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s and heals him, which is what makes Grievous Wounds decide the long trades.
